# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m152, Graphite, and perf fixes**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 bumps to Skia m152, adds Graphite GPU backend bindings, and fixes several native memory-safety bugs. Alongside the engine bump, this release adds async pixel reads, a new Vulkan-via-Silk.NET package, and Nano Server font support via FreeType, plus a batch of performance and use-after-free fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to m152, folding in upstream m151/m152 stability and bug fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds bindings for the Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, opening the door to Skia's next-generation GPU pipeline. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel reads** — Adds an async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface that works across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — Ships a new package wiring Vulkan through Silk.NET, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free fixes** — Fixes use-after-free crashes in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the owning native object for the lifetime of the returned handle. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed** — Fixes a native memory leak in the SKImage.Create raster failure path where the pixel buffer was not released. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support** — Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server, where the system font manager is unavailable. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **MSVC environment initialized once per native build** — Speeds up and stabilizes Windows native builds by initializing the MSVC environment a single time. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes HarfBuzzSharp to 14.2.1, carried along with the repo-wide solution and CI infrastructure updates in this release.
